issue.title: bgp#supervisord gave up: supervisor-proc-exit-listener entered FATAL state, too many start retries too quickly

failure.body:
**Description**

See many error related to BGP supervisord:

```
Jan 27 <IPV6>.677761 mts-sonic-dut ERR bgp#/supervisor-proc-exit-listener: Syntax of the line #012 in critical_processes file is incorrect. Exiting...
Jan 27 <IPV6>.700728 mts-sonic-dut INFO bgp#supervisord 2021-01-27 <IPV6>,699 ERRO pool dependent-startup event buffer overflowed, discarding event 92
Jan 27 <IPV6>.700728 mts-sonic-dut INFO bgp#supervisord 2021-01-27 <IPV6>,699 INFO exited: supervisor-proc-exit-listener (exit status 5; not expected)
Jan 27 <IPV6>.707610 mts-sonic-dut INFO bgp#supervisord 2021-01-27 <IPV6>,702 ERRO pool dependent-startup event buffer overflowed, discarding event 93
Jan 27 <IPV6>.711147 mts-sonic-dut INFO bgp#supervisord 2021-01-27 <IPV6>,705 INFO spawned: 'supervisor-proc-exit-listener' with pid 124
Jan 27 <IPV6>.910330 mts-sonic-dut ERR bgp#/supervisor-proc-exit-listener: Syntax of the line #012 in critical_processes file is incorrect. Exiting...
Jan 27 <IPV6>.933822 mts-sonic-dut INFO bgp#supervisord 2021-01-27 <IPV6>,932 ERRO pool dependent-startup event buffer overflowed, discarding event 94
Jan 27 <IPV6>.933822 mts-sonic-dut INFO bgp#supervisord 2021-01-27 <IPV6>,932 INFO exited: supervisor-proc-exit-listener (exit status 5; not expected)
Jan 27 <IPV6>.935428 mts-sonic-dut INFO bgp#supervisord 2021-01-27 <IPV6>,934 ERRO pool dependent-startup event buffer overflowed, discarding event 95
Jan 27 <IPV6>.938225 mts-sonic-dut INFO bgp#supervisord 2021-01-27 <IPV6>,937 INFO spawned: 'supervisor-proc-exit-listener' with pid 125
Jan 27 <IPV6>.131632 mts-sonic-dut ERR bgp#/supervisor-proc-exit-listener: Syntax of the line #012 in critical_processes file is incorrect. Exiting...
Jan 27 <IPV6>.153896 mts-sonic-dut INFO bgp#supervisord 2021-01-27 <IPV6>,153 ERRO pool dependent-startup event buffer overflowed, discarding event 96
Jan 27 <IPV6>.154392 mts-sonic-dut INFO bgp#supervisord 2021-01-27 <IPV6>,153 INFO exited: supervisor-proc-exit-listener (exit status 5; not expected)
Jan 27 <IPV6>.159353 mts-sonic-dut INFO bgp#supervisord 2021-01-27 <IPV6>,155 ERRO pool dependent-startup event buffer overflowed, discarding event 97
Jan 27 <IPV6>.159353 mts-sonic-dut INFO bgp#supervisord 2021-01-27 <IPV6>,156 INFO gave up: supervisor-proc-exit-listener entered FATAL state, too many start retries too quickly
Jan 27 <IPV6>.881332 mts-sonic-dut INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd Jan 27 <IPV6> INFO    LOG: Initializing SX log with STDOUT as output file.

```

The content of critical_processes in bgp docker is:

```
root@mts-sonic-dut:/# cat /etc/supervisor/critical_processes
program:zebra
program:staticd
program:bgpd
program:fpmsyncd
program:bgpcfgd

root@mts-sonic-dut:/#

```

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**

I did a few warm-reboot, but I am not sure if it is the reproduce step.

**Describe the results you received:**

See unexpected logs for bgp supervisord.

**Describe the results you expected:**

No such logs

**Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):**

Branch: master
Commit hash: 6957e37

resolution.title: [docker-fpm-frr]: fix proc-exit-listener crash
resolution.description:
**- Why I did it**
remove blank lines in criticial_process
make proc-exit-listener more robust to handle blank lines

**- How I did it**
see the pr

**- How to verify it**
